title: Auxiliary probe conservator: low-cost duplicated-path with charge-aware throttling
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: We need a safe, low-overhead path to exercise new model variants (canary/A-B) and offline evaluators without risking tenant billing surprises or production instability. Existing mirroring paths are powerful but expensive or lack tenant-credit isolation. Goal: build an auxiliary probe conservator — a configurable duplicated-path pipeline that guarantees: (1) bounded token spend per tenant, (2) non-intrusive backpressure and latency pass-through, (3) deterministic sample/shard policies, (4) traceable lineage for per-request comparisons, and (5) rapid auto-rollback when quality regressions or errors are detected. This ticket describes the orchestration, runtime hooks, safety controls, and rollout plan.
design_summary: Architecture: probe ingress (gateway hook) -> sampling policy engine -> duplication router -> credit ledger (per-tenant soft/hard limits) -> sandbox runtime pool (isolated nodes) -> result capture & diff pipeline. Key pieces: (a) Sampling engine supports probabilistic, stratified, and deterministic hashing by tenant/request-hash; (b) Credit ledger enforces a hard token budget and emits advisory signals so upstream can throttle mirrored duplicates; (c) Probe paths run on dedicated sandbox nodes with separate disk/metrics namespaces and optional KV-cache shadowing; (d) Trace propagation adds conserved IDs so outputs can be compared without ambiguity; (e) Auto-rollback uses a rolling evaluation window and configurable thresholds (error delta, latency delta, quality regression rate) to flip the probe off and optionally open a rollback issue/alert.
success_metrics: <1% additional average token spend on pilot tenants compared to baseline
No production tail-latency increase >5ms at the 99th percentile when mirroring is enabled
Auto-rollback triggers within 10 minutes of a sustained 3-sigma error or quality regression policy breach
Per-tenant monthly mirrored token charge never exceeds configured hard-budget (100% enforcement)
Detection and paired diff pipeline produces reports for 95% of mirrored requests with trace linkage
rollout_plan: Phase 0: deploy feature flags + sampling engine to staging; enable on internal tenants only. Phase 1: pilot with 5 low-traffic customers at 0.1% mirrored rate with strict hard-budget = 10k tokens/month. Phase 2: broaden to 50 tenants, introduce stratified sampling by endpoint and request-length, enable sandbox KV-cache shadowing for model families that rely on cache warming. Phase 3: opt-in in Console as beta (self-serve) with UI controls for budgets and sampling profiles. At each phase enable canary metrics and the auto-rollback rule. Rollout gate: successful load/chaos tests and review from security and billing teams.
observability_and_alerts: Dashboards: mirrored-token burn by tenant, mirror-success-rate, pair-latency-delta histogram, error-delta by model-variant, sandbox node health. Alerts: mirror token burn >85% of tenant soft-budget (warning), hard-budget breach (critical + auto-throttle), paired-error-delta >5% sustained for 5 minutes (critical + auto-rollback), 99th pair-latency-delta >150ms (warning). Traces: link original/mirrored spans with conserved ids; log diff summaries to S3 and surface small samples in Console.
safety_controls: Hard-budget enforcement at ingress to prevent token overrun; backpressure propagation to avoid head-of-line latency impact (mirrored requests may be dropped, queued to sandbox, or rate-limited); deterministic sampling options for reproducible A/B experiments; per-tenant quarantine mode to isolate tenants that cause high error deltas; sandbox execution with strict resource limits and no external side effects. All changes gated behind feature flags and RBAC in Console.
testing_plan: Unit tests for sampling engine and credit ledger. Integration tests: end-to-end duplication + diff pipeline in staging with synthetic workloads (latency spike, error spike, silent regressions). Load tests: validate 10k rps mirrored at 0.5% rate without >2% CPU increase on frontends. Chaos tests: simulate sandbox node failures and ensure mirrored path failures don't affect primary path. Billing tests: synthetic tenant usage to validate ledger enforcement and billing invariants. Include GitHub Actions integration with a canary cluster run.
acceptance_criteria: Feature flag toggles mirroring on/off with no primary path impact
Hard-budget prevents any mirrored token billing beyond configured limit in tests
Auto-rollback rule triggers and flips mirror off in response to synthetic regression
Observability surfaces paired-diff reports within 15 minutes for 90% of mirrored requests
Documentation + Console controls published and reviewed by PM/Design
comments: 2026-03-02 - Asha Patel: Initial write-up posted. Called out need for deterministic hashing to support reproducible A/B. Raised question about whether sandbox nodes should share KV-cache snapshots or maintain cold caches.

2026-03-04 - Diego Morales: Prototype of sampling engine complete (branch: feature/probe-sampler). Using reservoir sampling + request-hash mode. Observed no P50 impact in local harness. Opening PR for review.
2026-03-06 - Security review (Marina Chen): sandbox nodes must enforce egress rules and KMS access must be scoped. Marked security_review_required = true and requested design doc for KMS interaction.
2026-03-08 - PM review (Liam O'Connor): ask to add console controls for per-route sampling profiles and clear UX for tenant budget warnings. Added to acceptance_criteria.

2026-03-09 - Review comment (Infra): suggested adding a soft-failure mode where mirrored requests are written to a durable buffer if sandbox capacity is insufficient to avoid data loss for offline evals.

2026-03-11 - Diego Morales: ran staging load test (0.1% mirror at 5k rps). Observed mirrored-node OOM at peak when KV-cache shadowing enabled. Mitigation: cap concurrent mirrored KV prefetch and fall back to cold cache mode. Added follow-up sub-issue ENG-611225.

2026-03-12 - Asha Patel: decision made to implement credit-ledger hard-enforcement at the gateway and an advisory webhook for billing. Next steps: finalize PR, add e2e tests, schedule security re-review and billing sign-off.
notes: Trade-offs: completely synchronous mirroring preserves fidelity for diffs but increases coupling and risk to latency; we selected asynchronous sandboxed mirroring for safety with an opt-in strict mode for internal experiments. Cost accounting complexity is higher with per-tenant ledgers but prevents surprises and enables self-serve budgets in Console. Future work: integrate with Optimize to suggest sampling profiles by workload.
